steps.prompt:
Inspect all input files staged in $FLEET_INPUT_DIR/example/ and read the goal carefully:

${example.prompt}

1. Create a structured Swarm plan for this run via work_plan_set (threads[], disjoint tasks[], workspaceMode inherit|share|branch, and verifier tasks).
2. Spawn worker and verifier sessions with session_start/session_fork, link their sessionId and executionId in work_plan_set, and dispatch complete, self-contained briefs via board_post carrying verbatim acceptance criteria, exact output filenames, exact required identifiers/labels/formats from $FLEET_INPUT_DIR/example/ (never paraphrasing key contract names), and test requirements. Avoid unnecessary child-wake chatter (use wake: false on informational/closing notes).
3. Monitor progress via board_read (since cursor, waitSeconds: 25 inside code, or end your turn to wait for @coordinator auto-wake), resolve blockers, independently verify exact spec conformance against all verbatim requirements and tests before finalizing, and write all final deliverable files at the root of $FLEET_OUTPUT_DIR (preserving their relative path inside $FLEET_INPUT_DIR/example/, NEVER adding an example/ prefix — e.g. $FLEET_INPUT_DIR/example/pricing.py -> $FLEET_OUTPUT_DIR/pricing.py) plus a concise summary in $FLEET_OUTPUT_DIR/output.json.
